title: Gulden NDE 2837
content: I don't know how many days I was in the clinic but I was in the Izmir Ege University Neurosurgery Section. On the right temporal lobe was a bleeding and I had in my brain nine times more veins/arteries than an average human did. (I had a kind of veins/arteries accumulation.) This was the cause of the hemorrhaging. Since 06/06/2000, I was in the clinic but the date for surgery was on 20/06/2000, because the doctors had to make the decision which of the veins/arteries they had to cut out. In the three weeks of my time after the surgery in the clinic, I was conscious but I don't remember that, but raising above my bed. I felt raising up above my bed, taking direction to a white, very bright light. Meantime, I saw my uncle, who died one month ago, while passing me he said, 'Not yet.' I was surprised how I understood him without spoken words, but I felt very peaceful. Later a lady came to me, if I saw her now, I would recognize her. She took me to a wonderful place with mountains and said that this was the place of my life. The place we went was beautiful, but I said to her that this place is not my life's place. Then we came to a seashore with a little village and she said again that this place was my life, but I didn't know this place and I said to her that this is not the place of my life. After we travelled to some more very beautiful places, she said that I was not ready to stay in these places and asked me what I remembered about my life. The first thing I remembered was my mother and I fell with high speed down. I felt how I fell into my body, woke up, and asked my mother if she was my mother, who was sitting at my bed side. My mother was confused and said that she was my mother. I had a blanket on me, a gift from my close friend and I wanted her to verify this. I said the name of my boyfriend and wanted to know from her if he was real. She said that he was real and started crying. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 18.06.2000 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain 06.06.2000 TARİHİNDE BEYİN KANAMASI GEÇİRDİM VE 20.06.2000 TARİHİNDE BEYİN AMELİYATI OLDUM. AMELİYATTAN HEMEN SONRA HATIRLADIĞIM "TEK ŞEY" İ ARAŞTIRMAYA BAŞLADIM VE BUNUN ÖLÜME YAKIN DENEYİM OLDUĞUNU ÖĞRENDİM. Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) In that time, I was in the clinic and the surgery was just over. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal While I was in the clinic, I was conscious, too. I spoke to the visitors and could make jokes but while I recall only very few of this, I remember my experience like it was yesterday. I think the wonderful white light and the peace I felt can't be made forgotten by anything. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? From the beginning of my experience - raising above my body, till I fell into my body - I was conscious. Were your thoughts speeded up? Faster than usual Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening all at once There was no definition of time. Universe and dimension were not, because earth time can be scaled in seconds - in seconds, we changed places and travelled. Were your senses more vivid than usual? Incredibly more so Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. Nothing can compare to the white bright light I saw. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. It was like the communication was not with voice but with brain waves. We talked but didn't move lips. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes Not like a tunnel; it was like a path with a white light in the end. Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I saw my uncle. I saw a lady, whom I think was my guardian angel. And I met some people but I didn't felt like a stranger. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes I saw very bright white light. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Clearly mystical or unearthly realm DAĞLIK YEMYEŞİL BİR YER,DENİZ KIYISINDA KÜÇÜK BİR KASABA,ORMANIN İÇİNDE BAŞKA BİR YER... BURALARIN HEPSİNİN BENİM HAYATIM OLDUĞUNU SÖYLEDİLER VE SANKİ BURADA KALMAM GEREKİYORMUŞ GİBİ HİSSETTİRDİLER ANCAK BEN BURALARI TANIYIP BİLMEDİĞİMİ SÖYLEDİM. What emotions did you feel during the experience? Great happiness and great peace. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate %99U MÜSLÜMAN OLAN BİR ÜLKEDE MÜSLÜMAN BİR AİLENİN ÇOCUĞUYUM ANCAK DİNİ GEREKLİKLERİ YERİNE GETİRDİĞİM SÖYLENEMEZ. Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Conservative/fundamentalist ŞİMDİKİ İNANCIMI DİNE BAĞLILIK DEĞİL DE İNANÇLI OLARAK TANIMLAYABİLİRİZ. BENCE BU DİNLER ÜSTÜ BİR İNANÇ. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes The definition of peace is very personal. I learned that death is nothing to be scared of. I can write much better and beautifully, and I can make more beautiful paintings. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I meet people with more joy. I hardly get angry. My daily life is full of love and peaceful. I feel pleasure by helping to strangers. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Because I don't think my experience was unique to this world. That's why the words I use from earth can't define my experience. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes High premonition. In some places, I felt the energy of this place, in my body. People come to me when they have pain, and I can say where their pain is, before they say it to me, I touch the painful area and I can take it away. I think this has to do with raising up my bio-energy. I don't think I am a healer. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? To see my uncle was very important to me. The white light and the great peace was definitely wonderful emotion. My guardian angel and being greeted when we die made me not scared of death anymore. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I am now a happy person, smiling in my eyes, spreading positive energy in the places I go. I told my experience at first to my close friends, they were confused. My family knows only a little of this, because I know, they would not believe me. My physician said that the painkillers and drugs could have caused the feeling of living this experience. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I think you cannot interpret this, you only know that it is real. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I know. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? I think that my life ended at one point but I think I live the time which is a gift and that is why I try to make the best of it.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Not like a tunnel; it was like a path with a white light in the end.

arrival.other_being_detail: A lady the experiencer believed was her guardian angel; also 'some people' she met there.

environment.environment_other_detail: Wonderful place with mountains; seashore with a little village; other beautiful places (including a forested place).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Brain hemorrhage (right temporal lobe) with vascular malformation; NDE recalled immediately after brain surgery.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Raised in a Muslim family; described self as not fulfilling religious requirements prior to NDE; later described belief as 'above religions'.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (rising above bed) → movement along a path toward a very bright white light → encounter with deceased uncle ('Not yet') → accompanied by a lady/guardian-angel figure through multiple beautiful locations → told not ready to stay; asked what she remembered about life → remembered mother → rapid fall back into body and awakening.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The guide repeatedly identified several different beautiful locations as 'the place of my life,' but the experiencer rejected them as unfamiliar; return was triggered by recalling her mother and was followed by reality-check questions (mother, blanket gift, boyfriend).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'Not yet.'; 'Not like a tunnel; it was like a path with a white light in the end.'
